# Vendored third-party assets

## `qrcode.js`

- Project: qrcode-generator by Kazuhiko Arase
- Version: 1.4.4
- License: MIT
- Source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
- Status: vendored unmodified

The file is served only to render the payment QR in the browser from the UPI
intent string. Nothing is fetched from a CDN at runtime, so the checkout still
works on a locked-down network. The "QR Code" word mark is a registered
trademark of DENSO WAVE INCORPORATED.
